claim: Token-efficient RL methods that update the policy using only a subset of generated tokens (30–50% for S-GRPO, under 5% for T-SPMO) can substantially improve test-set accuracy over zero-shot baselines.
falsifier: Apply token-efficient RL to a different LLM and task; if accuracy improves over a zero-shot baseline, the claim is supported.

conditions: token selection strategies (stochastic sampling or token-level prefix matching)
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system (Qwen2-1.5B), tasks (SV AMP and multi-digit multiplication), and specific token selection hyperparameters; transfer beyond these conditions is unestablished.
